sentences.text:
The instant writ petition is preferred to challenge the order dated 20.05.2014 (Annex.1) passed by the Additional District Magistrate, Bikaner.
One of the ground raised for challenging the order
is that no Tribunal has been constituted under the Food Safety and Standards Act and thus, the petitioner is rendered remediless.
Mr. Jain does not dispute the fact that the Tribunal has now been constituted.
Thus, the petitioner is relegated to approach the (2 of 2) [CW-4298/2015] Tribunal for challenging the impugned order.
In case, an appeal is filed before the Tribunal within a period of 30 days from today, the same shall be treated to be within limitation and shall be decided as per law.
With these observations and directions, the instant writ petition is disposed of.

(SANDEEP MEHTA), J.
